subject: psychology
title: Brain & Neuropsychology: Exam-Style Stretch
welcome_lead: Compare brain scans and explain neurons like a clinical neuropsychologist.
meta_desc: GCSE Psychology exam stretch on neuropsychology: scanning techniques, neurons and neurotransmitters.
final_note: You can evaluate scanning methods and the neuron at speed.

concepts.def: Static X-ray-based image of brain structure.
Scans showing brain activity via blood flow.
Gap between neurons crossed by neurotransmitters.

walkthroughs.body_html: CT: cheap, X-ray, only structure. MRI: clear structure with no radiation. fMRI: shows activity in real time. PET: tracks glucose use. The right tool depends on whether you want structure or function.

Signals enter at dendrites, travel down the axon as an electrical impulse, and trigger release of neurotransmitters across the synapse. The next neuron's receptors pick them up and the message continues.

walkthroughs.h2: Strengths and limits of brain studies
walkthroughs.body_html: Strengths: objective, scientific, identifying treatments. Limits: reductionist — reducing complex behaviour to neurons; correlation does not equal causation in scan studies; expensive equipment limits sample sizes.
